etch.markup:
<filter id="worldbend-etch" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
<feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.333" numOctaves="2" seed="7" result="bump"/>
<feDiffuseLighting in="bump" lighting-color="white" surfaceScale="0.1" diffuseConstant="1" result="light">
<feDistantLight azimuth="235" elevation="55"/>
</feDiffuseLighting>
<feComposite in="light" in2="bump" operator="arithmetic" k1="1" k2="0" k3="0" k4="0" result="etched"/>
<feColorMatrix in="etched" type="saturate" values="0"/>
</filter>

fidelity.note: visible=false omits the texture declarations entirely
grain density scales turbulence alpha coverage; it does not select sparse cells with Figma's native noise algorithm
grain size scales the 64px tile by its 0.16 noise frequency for nominal cell pitch; the cell shapes differ from native noise
grain color tints the tile pixels
SVG bump lighting approximates native TEXTURE etch; surfaceScale linear to 12 then soft tail to 100 (effective 0.4, clamped=false)
etch size becomes feTurbulence frequency, not the native cell pitch
clip-to-shape controls etch's rounded CSS outline; grain always follows the outline. Other Figma vector silhouettes require a host clip or mask

parameterRanges.note: Web etch surfaceScale is linear on [0,12] then a soft tail through 100; values above 100 clamp

couplings.note: This Web profile also changes artwork saturation; use web-color-preserving when refraction must retain the sampled color treatment
Dispersion shares the same saturate compensation channel as refraction

fidelity.note: visible=false omits the glass declarations entirely
frost radius maps to the backdrop-filter blur length
drives the inset edge highlight strength; Figma's full specular response is richer
positions the inset highlight on the lit edge; cardinals match native/Metal (oblique at 115°)
edge-only displacement; also intentionally raises backdrop-filter saturate (see couplings)
scales edge displacement (linear to depth 10, soft tail to 100; effective 8, clamped=false) and rim width (linear to 20, soft tail to 100)
RGB channel separation in the Web runtime; an approximation rather than a spectral solver

lightAxis.note: Shared Figma/Web/Metal screen-space mapping: 0 down, 90 left, 180 up, 270 right; Web inset highlight uses this vector on the lit edge

parameterRanges.note: Web displacement depthFactor is linear on [1,10] then a soft tail through 100; values above 100 clamp
Web receiver rim uses clamped authored depth on [1,100] (historical linear [1,20] then soft tail); mapped rim contribution is delivery.rimDepth (max 40)
